conditions.runtime: Authenticated player in an open permitted Shipping Box or other explicitly permitted currency container; matching Economy network protocol and sufficient ledger-backed coins/balance.

change.summary: Shipping Box left exchange accepts an exact source count with whole-group conversion, while right deposit and withdrawal use one selected denomination and exact coin count.

modifiers.before: Separate redundant controls and a whole-request divisibility check could reject a partial whole-group conversion.
modifiers.after: Source field defaults to exchangeable backed inventory count; floor whole conversion groups are consumed, remainder stays, target count is derived, and server rechecks provenance, space and ledger reservation.

modifiers.before: Deposit action swept all eligible inventory coins; withdrawal decomposed requested value into mixed denominations.
modifiers.after: Deposit consumes exactly the selected denomination and count; withdrawal debits the exact value and issues exactly that denomination/count; wallet transfer uses selected count times denomination.

rationale.purpose: Make displayed coin quantities match exact ledger-backed physical exchange, deposit and withdrawal while preserving total money and replay protection.
rationale.decision_source: User requested the Shipping Box changes in the 2026-10-26 plan. Codex chose whole-group conversion that leaves an unconvertible remainder, as stated in the plan.

introduced.summary: Shipping Box left exchange accepts an exact source count with whole-group conversion, while right deposit and withdrawal use one selected denomination and exact coin count.

history.summary: Shipping Box left exchange accepts an exact source count with whole-group conversion, while right deposit and withdrawal use one selected denomination and exact coin count.

relations: Client receives authoritative balance plus total backed counts and counts eligible for exchange from ordinary inventory slots.
Ledger reserves, validates and commits exact physical actions; other depositAll consumers remain.
notes: Screen layout at different GUI scales and a native interaction are unobserved without a gameplay launch.
